place.name: Praia do Cassino
place.description: Praia do Cassino (Portuguese for Casino Beach) is the world's longest sea beach and is in the southernmost part of the Brazilian coast (33°07′34″S 52°38′20″W), on the South Atlantic Ocean, in the Rio Grande do Sul state. The beach is treated by some as the longest uninterrupted ocean sandy beach in the world, with estimates of 212 kilometres (132 mi) to 254 kilometres (158 mi); but this claim is hard to make due to the coastline paradox.
